displaced.rests: Brief: Field Metering ~6,000 people, ~70% automatable within 18 months.

exposed.rests: Day-30 exposure model: task-based automatability per job family, adjusted for what the Client has procured (A18).
exposed.how: Sum over 12 families of headcount x automatable share

natural.rests: HRIS date of birth; retirement age 56 per PKB (A12, A13).

placed.rests: Pathway success 90 / 80 / 60% by adjacency, second offer converts half the rest (A10); adjacency segments 1,900 / 1,100 / 550 (A20).

vol.rests: Opt-in only: 120 enhanced early retirement, 95 supported external moves (A5).
vol.how: Remainder after second offers, split by choice

pool.rests: People with no viable path after two offers keep grade, pay and productive work.

retained.rests: ~30% of Field Metering work remains after automation (brief).

other.rests: Internal-first rule on ~1,300 enterprise vacancies a year (A17).

invest.rests: Reskilling, voluntary packages, assessments, programme, technology, Rakamin fee (A2-A9).

doNothing.rests: 3,150 roles hired externally over 18 months at Rp 180M per FTE (A1, round planning assumption, not Client data).
